title: Java stories vs Python stories on points
question: Does a story about Java get more points than a story about Python?
author: film-cards
hypothesis: A story about Java gets more points than a story about Python.
expect: If true, points per story for Java stories should be at least 1.5x the value for Python stories, over all stories from 2006 to 2026 (1.1x is weak, 0.9x or lower refutes it).

check.per_label: points per story, Java against Python

thresholds_note: Thresholds are the ones used on h370, set before this card was run and not tuned to its result. h318 is left unchanged.
caveats: Points are the score each story had when the archive fetched it, so 2025 and 2026 stories may still be gaining points.
A title that names a theme is not proof the story is about it, and one story can sit in both groups.
Both groups are title words only, so stories that never name the theme are missed.
h318 asked a different question; this card compares two groups head to head.
